name: agent-panel
description: Agent panels and ping-pong planning with Claude subagents at a chosen model and effort

save.title: Save answers
save.description: Where each seat's answer is kept: files under the runs folder, a Solo scratchpad per run, both, or off. save=<mode> on a command overrides it for that run.

runsDir.title: Runs folder
runsDir.description: Where saved answers go when Save answers is files or both, one folder per project and run.

skillDirs.title: Skill folders
skillDirs.description: Folders holding <skill>/SKILL.md that +skill on a seat loads from, comma separated, ahead of the session's own skills. skills=<folder> on a command or a preset's own folders come first.

soloBriefs.title: Solo briefs
soloBriefs.description: Also read briefs from Solo prompt templates named brief-<name>.
